Check that a dataset is compatible with NONMEM

Source: R/nm_check_dataset.R
nm_check_dataset.Rd

Reads a dataset as NONMEM would (every value as text, . or an empty cell as missing) and reports the problems that make NM-TRAN refuse the data or NONMEM misread them. The data are never modified.

Usage

nm_check_dataset(data, cols = NULL, sep = ",", outlier_k = 4, verbose = TRUE)

Arguments

data

Path of a CSV file, or a data frame (for example the data element of nm_read_csv()).

cols

Optional named character vector giving the column of a standard item when its name differs, e.g. c(ID = "SUBJ", DV = "CONC"). Names are otherwise matched without regard to case.

sep

Column separator of the CSV file (default ",").

outlier_k

Number of median absolute deviations (log DV) beyond which an observation is reported as an outlier (default 4).

verbose

Print the report (default TRUE).

Value

An object of class nm_dataset_check: a list with findings (one row per problem found: check, severity "error" or "warning", column, n_rows, rows (row numbers in the data, header excluded), ids and message), n_rows, n_subjects, columns (standard item -> column used) and ok (TRUE when no error was found). Printed (invisibly returned) when verbose = TRUE.

Details

Checks:

  • columns: ID, TIME and DV present (error); AMT absent (warning: no dose record);

  • missing ID or TIME values (error);

  • non-numeric values in a column (error; NONMEM reads numbers only, unless the column is dropped in $INPUT);

  • times: TIME decreasing within a subject (error), except at a reset record (EVID 3 or 4);

  • EVID / MDV / AMT: EVID outside 0 to 4 (error); dose record (EVID 1 or 4) without a positive AMT (error); observation (EVID 0) with a positive AMT (error); MDV 0 with a missing DV (error); MDV 0 on a record that is not an observation (error); observation with MDV 1 but a DV (warning: the value is ignored); without EVID, a record with AMT > 0 is a dose and MDV must be 1;

  • duplicates: identical records (warning); two observations of the same subject, time and compartment with different DV (warning);

  • outliers in the observed DV: negative values (warning) and values far from the observations taken at the same time after the last dose (log scale, more than outlier_k median absolute deviations from their median; per compartment when CMT exists; groups of at least 10 observations) (warning).

The header line may start with # or @ (#ID,TIME,...), as read with IGNORE=# or IGNORE=@ in $DATA.

Examples

ex <- system.file("extdata", "example", package = "nmpilot")
chk <- nm_check_dataset(file.path(ex, "example_data.csv"))
#> <nm_dataset_check> example_data.csv 
#>   600 records, 60 subjects: 0 error(s), 1 warning(s) -> readable by NONMEM
#>   [WARNING] Observed DV far from the others taken at the same time after dose (more than 4 median absolute deviations from their median, log scale, per CMT). (4 record(s): rows 59, 98-100; ID 6, 10)
chk$ok
#> [1] TRUE
chk$findings
#>      check severity column n_rows         rows   ids
#> 1 outliers  warning     DV      4 59, 98, .... 6, 10
#>                                                                                                                                             message
#> 1 Observed DV far from the others taken at the same time after dose (more than 4 median absolute deviations from their median, log scale, per CMT).
